title: 4031. Find All Numbers Disappeared in an Array II

examples.explanation: The missing integers are [1, 2, 4, 5, 6, 8, 10, 11, 12]. Grouping the missing integers into the minimum number of contiguous ranges, we get [1, 2], [4, 6], [8, 8], and [10, 12]. Therefore, the answer is [[1, 2], [4, 6], [8, 8], [10, 12]].
The missing integers are [5, 6, 7]. Grouping the missing integers into the minimum number of contiguous ranges, we get [5, 7]. Therefore, the answer is [[5, 7]].
There are no missing integers. Therefore, the answer is [].
